notes.title: V1.4 — The One Where We Stopped Fighting With Our Own Database
notes.description: Bulk import no longer trips over its own shoelaces. Legacy table ghosts can't crash the party anymore, warnings can be squashed in one click, and every dashboard now reads from the same single source of truth. Cleaner, faster, calmer.

notes.title: Smart Import: No More Duplicate Key Tantrums
notes.description: Bulk commit used to crash mid-flight if legacy tables were missing — like trying to sit in a chair someone already moved. Now those deletes are properly guarded, and old work items get cleaned up regardless of whether they were filed under 'NPT::' or '::PLAN::'. Import away without fear.

notes.title: Resolve All Warnings Button
notes.description: Tired of clicking through 47 warnings one by one before you can commit? Same. The new 'Resolve All Warnings' button in the bulk commit panel clears every non-blocker warning across all your pending files in one satisfying click. You're welcome.

notes.title: One Table To Rule Them All
notes.description: Every dashboard — Portfolio, My Work, PM On-The-Go, Planning, Gamification, Milestones, Quality — now reads from the canonical work_items table. No more 'but the numbers are different on that other screen' conversations. One table, one truth, zero arguments.

notes.title: Legacy Table Graceful Degradation
notes.description: If a legacy table has been archived or doesn't exist, the app no longer panics and throws errors at your face. It quietly moves on, like a mature adult. All project_plan and normalized_plan_tasks operations are wrapped in safety guards so the new database structure just works.

notes.title: Backfill: Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger
notes.description: The work_items backfill now handles each legacy source table independently. If one table is missing, the others still migrate just fine. Think of it as a relay team where one runner tripping doesn't disqualify the whole squad.
